svg.title: DenoiseLab: real held-out reconstruction, including stronger controls
svg.desc: First official test row with the fixed 32-pixel mask. Four 1797-row audits compare hidden-pixel MSE; nearest neighbor and PCA beat the neural net at 16 missing pixels.
svg.text: DenoiseLab / manual gradients, learned weights, strong controls
Same observed pixels. No model sees the erased targets. First test row, fixed 32-pixel mask.
Official test: mean hidden-pixel squared error / 1,797 digits per pattern
At 16 missing pixels, nearest neighbor and PCA beat this network. No universal winner.
Scattered-32 training only. Fixed block masks are a disclosed distribution shift, not a causal test.
Alpaydin & Kaynak (1998), UCI Optical Digits, CC BY 4.0. Code: MIT. No endorsement.
No calibrated uncertainty, image-file OCR, generation, semantic-preservation or real-world guarantee.
